spanish: Y dijeron a Moisés, diciendo: Multiplica el pueblo a traer, más que bastancia del servicio para la obra que mandó Jehová a hacerla.

findings.issue: Hiphil participle masculine plural has the people as the ones multiplying to bring. Singular Multiplica, opening the quotation, also reads as a tú command to multiply the people.

notes: The other tokens match, including Jehová and the feminine object in hacerla.
